entries.08fdee6dfcde6ed8: As its management policy, it sets out constantly evolving "a store that serves as a foundation for daily life," through a rich assortment aligned with the needs of local residents and the provision of products at low prices through thorough low-cost operations. In its medium-term management plan covering through the fiscal year ending September 2026, it sets strengthening earning power as its most important issue, and works on the development of PB products and "communication of value" through coordination among products, sales, and advertising, and on "R-9," a business reform that seeks to rationalize operations through mechanization and the use of self-checkouts. Its priority measures are reform of the earnings structure, which maintains the advantage of low prices through cost suppression via productivity improvement and the use of DX, and the creation of prosperous stores through improvement of sales capability, product capability, and customer service levels. In its capital policy, it sets out strengthening shareholder returns and active IR activities.
